screens.screen: blog home (search, category tabs with counts, post cover list)
post details / reader (save + share actions, reading progress bar, cover, category pill, reading time, HTML article)
my library - saved tab (offline-readable saved posts)

notes: It IS a Flutter app (AbberApp/abberblog v1.1.2+10, 'مدونة عبر'), Arabic-only, RTL, Material 3; cloned to repos/abberblog. Colours/typography from lib/core/themes, font = repo ReadexPro, icons = real Solar linear icon font (codepoints from AppIcons). Fidelity doubt to know about: in the app a post card is ONLY the cover image (188px, no title widget) and covers are network images from the production blog, which could not be read here; the covers drawn are brand-styled SAMPLE covers (Abber navy/gold palette, title baked into the image), not the real artwork. Category names/counts, article titles and the article text are sample content (total 392 matches the count shown on abber.co/blog). Library TabBar uses Material 3 default colours derived from the navy seed (approximated). 96x72 library thumbnails are a centre-crop of the cover, as BoxFit.cover does. gen.py in this folder regenerates the three HTML files.
